**Context:** Early October: Northwind Utilities firmware v2.3 issue was blocking the go-live plan.

**What happened:** A firmware-fix request went to the customer's general support inbox. Response time was 11 days, delaying planning for the v2.4 fix.

**What we learned:** For time-critical requests with external vendors or customers (especially on critical path items), establish a dedicated technical contact during kickoff and maintain direct escalation path. Bypassing general support channels and using direct contact reduced response time from 11+ days to same-day.
